title: Ya y Todavía No While Travelling

sections.content: Combine ya and todavía no with travel vocabulary to describe progress during a trip. Use ya for completed activities and todavía no for activities that remain to be done. Both expressions work with the same pretérito perfecto forms you learned in the first three lessons.

items.english: We have already travelled along the path.

items.spanish: Todavía no hemos visto el templo.
items.english: We have not seen the temple yet.
I have already taken a photograph.

items.spanish: Todavía no hemos llegado al pueblo.
items.english: We have not reached the village yet.

sections.content: Choose between ya and todavía no according to whether the action has happened by now.
